Class SensorStationService

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.services.SensorStationService
@Service public class SensorStationService extends Object
Service layer for managing SensorStation entities.

This service handles CRUD operations, state transitions, and synchronization of sensor stations with associated Raspberry Pi devices.

Responsibilities include:

  • Managing sensor station lifecycle (create, update, delete)
  • Assigning stations to Raspberry Pi and rooms
  • Synchronizing configuration with Raspberry Pi devices
  • Handling device status transitions

      public SensorStation update(Long piId, Long id, DeviceStatus status)
      Updates the device status of a sensor station belonging to a specific Raspberry Pi.

      This method ensures that the station is actually assigned to the given Pi.

      Parameters:
      piId - Raspberry Pi ID
      id - sensor station ID
      status - new device status
      Returns:
      updated sensor station
      Throws:
      NotFoundException - if station does not belong to the given Pi

    • update

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'BUILDING_ADMIN')") public SensorStation update(Long id, SensorStationUpdateDTO dto, Integer measurementInterval)
      Updates a sensor station including measurement interval and triggers Raspberry Pi synchronization if the station is in AVAILABLE state.

      If the station is successfully set up on the Raspberry Pi, a follow-up connect request is sent.

      Parameters:
      id - sensor station ID
      dto - update data
      measurementInterval - new measurement interval
      Returns:
      updated sensor station
